scientific_claim.purpose: Verify the real ASE/icet wrapper, deterministic seed handling, structure writing, and immutable generation manifest on one bounded Li-M-P-S candidate.

implementation.post_smoke_change_scope: Result-contract metadata only. The icet call, parameters, seed derivation, and structure writing behavior are unchanged.

limitations: The 100-step run is an integration smoke only and is not a converged or production-quality SQS search.
The historical generator did not expose a seed, so this proves deterministic new execution rather than byte parity with a historical structure.
The bounded smoke and recorded cluster vector do not prove SQS global optimality.
Recorded ASE/icet versions identify the implementation environment; version agreement or change does not establish scientific structure parity.
The external prototype is referenced by path but is not copied into the public repository pending data-sharing review.
